title: Work IQ: real-time Teams meeting and call transcripts through MCP
summary: The documented Teams controls, default state, consumption licensing and roadmap targets are supported. One clarification remains: the setup guide describes a one-time Global Administrator setup, while the MCP overview says provisioning normally happens automatically on first use.

claims.quote: Work IQ enables authorized applications and AI agents to access transcript content from supported Microsoft Teams meetings and calls as conversations unfold.

claims.claim: The roadmap also covers transcript access from supported Teams calls.
claims.quote: access transcript content from supported Microsoft Teams meetings and calls as conversations unfold.

claims.claim: Learn documents apps and agents receiving Teams meeting transcripts while the meeting is in progress.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting settings > Transcript API access > WorkIQ access reaches the control.
claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global enables real-time transcript access.
claims.quote:
When set to true, agents and apps can access real-time transcripts through Work IQ.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription reaches the meeting transcription control.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one.
Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true allows meeting transcription for the policy.
claims.quote:
To allow specific users in your organization to transcribe, run the following commands:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described actions triggered by the live transcript feed itself.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ real time transcript feed triggers actions workflow automation. Opened transcript API access, Work IQ overview, API overview and MCP policy governance; they describe access and general agent actions, not actions automatically triggered by this feed.

claims.claim: Learn separately documents tenant-level policy controls for Work IQ MCP.
claims.quote: In the initial release, Work IQ MCP provides tenant-level policy control. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, tenant administrators can turn Work IQ MCP policy on or off for the tenant.

claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly map its MCP policy controls to this planned live-transcript capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ live transcripts MCP policy consent permissions. Opened policy governance, MCP overview, transcript API access, permissions and tool reference. Policy applies to MCP tool requests, but these pages identify no live-transcript MCP tool or explicit mapping.

claims.claim: The cited transcript-access page gives no explicit navigation path to grant the required Work IQ app permissions.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ real time live transcript MCP permissions consent tools. Read transcript API access: its Work IQ conditions name required Entra permissions without steps; its Configure/link-to-Entra instructions concern Microsoft Graph transcript access.

claims.claim: The roadmap names no specific permissions or consent procedure for live-transcript MCP access.
claims.quote: The capability uses an active Teams transcript feed and requires applicable permissions and consent; it does not automatically start transcription.

claims.claim: An earlier roadmap item also describes Work IQ real-time Teams meeting transcript access for apps and agents.
claims.quote: 570651: Enable applications and agents to access Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in real time for assistance and insights. Created: 2026-10-19T23:15:15.

claims.where: controls[1].scope, note; rendered table; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The existing user meeting policy controls whether transcription can run.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting. For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.

claims.claim: Allowing transcription does not itself authorise apps to receive the transcript through Work IQ.
claims.quote:
Turning on Work IQ access doesn't, by itself, give apps a transcript. An app receives a real-time transcript only when these conditions are also met:
Transcription is running.
The app acts on behalf of a signed-in user and has the permissions it needs in Microsoft Entra ID.
